titulo: My Apartment Came With a Key to a Room That Doesn't Exist #Shorts
titulo_pt: Meu apartamento veio com a chave de um quarto que não existe
resumo_pt: A narradora aluga um apartamento de um quarto, mas o chaveiro vem com uma segunda chave. Ela acha uma porta pintada atrás do guarda-roupa, e a chave abre. Lá dentro, um quartinho com uma cama desfeita, ainda quente, e fotos dela dormindo tiradas de dentro do armário. A virada: enquanto ela olha, a porta do apartamento é trancada por dentro.
descricao:
The listing said one bedroom. The key ring said otherwise.

Would you have opened that door?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Fictional story. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: The listing said one bedroom. But my key ring came with two keys.

scenes.text: The landlord said the second one was nothing.

scenes.text: A week later, I moved the wardrobe. There was a door behind it. Painted over.

scenes.text: Inside was a tiny room. A bed. Unmade.

scenes.text: I touched the sheets. They were still warm.

scenes.text: On the wall, photos. Dozens of them.

scenes.text: Then I heard it. Behind me. In my apartment.

scenes.text: Someone had just locked my front door. From the inside.
